verdict.rationale: Dropbox provides official first-party SDKs in multiple languages (Swift, .NET, Java, JavaScript, Objective-C, Python), backed by public GitHub repos and API docs covering file operations, OAuth, and webhooks, giving developers a solid foundation to build custom (including AI-driven) integrations. Missing for 10: no evidence of an AI-agent-specific SDK/toolkit or independent third-party corroboration of SDK reliability/quality beyond Dropbox's own docs and repos.
